experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Led the development of the eFiche Mobile App, driving fast delivery and maintaining high code quality standards throughout the project lifecycle.
Owned key features end-to-end — from requirement discussions to production deployment — demonstrating consistent ownership and reliability.
Contributed significantly to both backend (Laravel) and frontend (Next.js), ensuring seamless integration and a polished user experience.
Proactively identified and resolved blockers for the team, helping maintain development momentum and meeting delivery timelines.
Maintained rigorous coding standards and self-imposed quality gates, keeping bug rates low and the codebase clean.
Actively contributed ideas and technical solutions that supported eFiche's growth and product reliability.
